title: Describe a Weather Backup Plan

source.rights: 项目原创虚构教学材料；AI 编写并对照教学规则、原文和题目证据复核。
source.reviewScope: Ordinary A2 practice. Exact source contexts and answers reviewed; synthetic en-US audio checked for file integrity, decoding, role/segment alignment and unprompted ASR content. Pronunciation and intonation are not independently certified.

instructions: Prepare briefly, then record your own answer. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
prompt: Describe an outdoor activity you would like to arrange. Explain what weather you expect, what evidence you can see, and what you will do if conditions change. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
reference: I would like to have a picnic with my friends near a lake in spring. I will check the weather forecast the night before and again in the morning. I think the day will be warm, but it might be windy. If I see a dark cloud, I will take an umbrella. If it is going to rain, we will use a nearby cafe instead of sitting outside. We will go indoors immediately if we hear thunder or see lightning. I enjoy sunshine, but a little rain will not end our plan. The important thing is to tell everyone both meeting places before they leave home. Then nobody needs to wait in the wrong place.
